full_page.content:
c. 1952, August 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
August 14h -- Vigil of our dearest BL. Mother Mary's Assumption
Blessed be God In all His designs!
Mr. Philip M. O'Brien Bailey's Harbor, Wis.
God bless you Mr. Philip O'Brien - you and yours,
We all hope this finds you well - which, for one ex- periencing what you have been going through these several months, must mean that you are keeping up courage and by the grace of God continuing to foster confidence in His merciful wisdom and goodness - all the better of course if the physical condition, at least does non get worse, till we see a decided im- provement and final recovery, God willing.
The purpose of this card, since I cannot finish the letter I wanted to send you, is primarily, to just reassure you that we are keeping you in mind and please God will not forget you in our prayers.
(No Signature)
